exposure: Timing of postpartum discharge (early vs. standard)
outcome: Inappropriate pediatric emergency department visits within 28 days of delivery
cohort: 546 newborns delivered at a single maternity department during the COVID-19 outbreak (June 1 to August 31, 2020)
finding: Early postpartum discharge, implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic, did not significantly increase the need for inappropriate emergency department visits or hospital readmissions within 28 days postpartum compared to standard discharge.
